headline: Intuit shares slump 10% on agreement to sell Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
summary: Intuit agreed to sell email marketing platform Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for approximately $3.68 billion. The sale price represents a steep discount from the nearly $12 billion Intuit paid five years ago.
why: Intuit is a financial software developer known for products such as TurboTax, QuickBooks, and Credit Karma.

impacts.name: Intuit
impacts.why: Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp at a fraction of its original acquisition price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
